svg.title: A behavior-preserving extraction makes later integration smaller
svg.desc: The proposed integration sequence shares preparation P1 before confirmation K1 depends on it. S0 and P1 retain preview behavior and no confirmation function. Executed reference checks preserve specified cases and test valid and invalid confirmation in K1; no production route or transaction is claimed.
svg.text: Make the preparation shared before the feature grows
Fictional stages · dependency arrows are a plan, not completed commits
Inline quantity validation; expected error codes and data-row numbering.
Review, check against current mainline, and integrate the preparation
Preview now calls validateQuantity; response and errors stay the same.
Confirmation remains absent; five quantity cases and row-2 case pass.
K1 starts from shared P1; check the feature and the combined version
K1 · confirmation uses the same validator
P201:3 accepted, 1 reference write; P201:3.5 rejected, 0 writes.
Earlier preview cases still pass; full acceptance and release remain.
Same preview expectations at S0, P1 and K1
0 and 3 accepted; −1 nonnegative error; 3.5 whole-number error.
501 maximum error; second invalid data record reports row 2.
Reference module checks passed. No actual integration or release occurred.
